q: The Ornstein–Weiss theorem (1980) extends Dye's theorem to:
opts: All free ergodic actions of countably infinite amenable groups (they are all orbit equivalent to each other)
exp: Ornstein–Weiss: for any two countably infinite amenable groups Γ,Λ, their free ergodic actions are orbit equivalent. The orbit equivalence class is unique for all amenable groups — the orbit structure only depends on the fact that the group is infinite amenable, not on which one.
